retell.title: Say it three times
retell.subtitle: Say the same idea more smoothly each round
retell.cardSubtitle: Plan for 30 seconds, then say it in 90, 60 and 45 seconds
retell.cardDone: Done for today. Feel free to go again.
retell.howPlan: Take {sec} seconds to plan. Jot down a few keywords if you like.
retell.howRounds: Say the same thing in English three times: {a}s, then {b}s, then {c}s.
retell.howWhy: Shrinking time pushes you to say the same ideas more smoothly. It's one of the most effective fluency exercises.
retell.noMic: Voice input isn't available here, so you'll type instead.
retell.planHint: Your opinion and two reasons are enough. No need for full sentences.
retell.roundHintFirst: Say what you think. Mistakes are fine, just keep going.
retell.roundHintAgain: Say the same thing again with less time. Try to be smoother and faster.
retell.micFailed: Voice input stopped. Type to keep going.
retell.nextHint: Next round: only {sec} seconds for the same content.
retell.wpmNote: More words per minute each round means you're getting more fluent.
